name: TableAway
summary:
Your table. Somewhere else.

Bring a different setting to your real table with TableAway. Eat, write or sketch while your physical tabletop stays visible through passthrough.

Explore three photographic 360-degree still environments: Secluded Beach, Alps Field and Monbachtal Riverbank. These three environments stay free permanently, with unlimited use and all core tabletop controls.
